artifacts.synopsis: Northern California Presbytery adopted an abstract resolution declaring six different views on the diaconate permissible for ministers and Sessions; the SJC sustained the complaints and annulled the resolution, holding that no court may issue binding abstract decrees beyond its proper jurisdictional exercise. A concurring opinion analyzed each of the six diaconal views in detail and set out standards (the GUMP/Kniseley framework) for when diaconal assistant practices are constitutionally permissible.

artifacts.title: Overture defining roles of unordained deaconesses and deacon assistants

matches.evidence: CCB found Grace Presbytery's overture on deaconesses and women officers in conflict with the Constitution, noting the session, not the congregation, is the appointing body requiring vows.

artifacts.title: Appointing unordained men and women to diaconal ministry roles

matches.evidence: CCB found an overture appointing unordained persons to diaconal ministry in conflict with the Constitution, including because it implied an unordained office contrary to BCO 17-1.

artifacts.title: Constitutional conflict in overture prohibiting deaconesses

matches.evidence: CCB found an overture prohibiting deaconesses in conflict with the Constitution because 'deaconess' need not denote an ordained office equivalent to deacon.

artifacts.title: Constitutional conflict in overture prohibiting diaconal assistants

matches.evidence: CCB found an overture prohibiting commissioned or installed assistants to deacons in conflict with the Constitution on the same grounds as the deaconess overture.
